genuine-capability-expansion.description: Rust accepts a Babel-rejected input and an executable oracle proves the newly supported behavior.

intentional-runtime-error.description: Rust preserves ordinary JavaScript evaluation for an input whose execution intentionally throws; acceptance is not advertised as a compiler capability.

validation-regression.description: Rust accepts an input that the current Fict specification requires the compiler to reject.

fallback-only.description: Rust accepts the input only behind a structured fallback diagnostic; it is not a guaranteed native lowering capability.

reactive-equivalence-required.description: Rust emits runnable code but the observable value does not update after its reactive dependency changes.

intentional-breaking-policy.description: Rust intentionally changes a Babel diagnostic policy and requires an explicit migration contract instead of a capability claim.

reviews.reason: Babel rejects reassignment of a local alias derived from state, while Rust currently accepts it as a mutable snapshot.
reviews.finalPlan: Restore a hard reactive-alias write diagnostic with the assignment span.
reviews.removalCondition: Remove this review when Rust rejects the fixture with the stable alias-write diagnostic.

reviews.reason: Post-declaration state alias propagation is not carried into the later reassignment check.
reviews.finalPlan: Propagate reactive alias shape through assignments and reject the later write.
reviews.removalCondition: Remove this review when Rust rejects the fixture with the stable alias-write diagnostic.

reviews.reason: Rust lowers a regular TypeScript enum and the runtime oracle proves forward and reverse enum lookup.
reviews.finalPlan: Keep the executable enum oracle in the native runtime gate.
reviews.removalCondition: Remove only if enum lowering is retired or the Babel baseline begins accepting the same request.

reviews.reason: Rust lowers the audited const-enum request to runnable enum behavior that Babel's configured pipeline rejects.
reviews.finalPlan: Keep the executable enum oracle in the native runtime gate.
reviews.removalCondition: Remove only if const-enum lowering is retired or the Babel baseline begins accepting the same request.

reviews.reason: A no-return advisory is emitted, but the required reactive-alias reassignment error is missing.
reviews.finalPlan: Restore a hard alias-write diagnostic without suppressing independent advisories.
reviews.removalCondition: Remove this review when Rust rejects the fixture for the alias write.

reviews.reason: The emitted eager self-reference follows JavaScript TDZ behavior and intentionally throws ReferenceError at execution.
reviews.finalPlan: Keep this as a JavaScript runtime-semantics probe, not a capability expansion claim.
reviews.removalCondition: Remove if eager self-references become a documented compile-time rejection.

reviews.reason: Rust correctly preserves continue/finally completion behavior for the audited state-machine lowering.
reviews.finalPlan: Keep the executable completion-value oracle.
reviews.removalCondition: Remove only if this control-flow lowering is retired or Babel accepts the request.

reviews.reason: The do-while result remains stale after its state dependency changes from 2 to 4.
reviews.finalPlan: Lower the loop into a reactive region or reject it with a stable unsuppressible guarantee diagnostic.
reviews.removalCondition: Remove this review when the second observation is updated or compilation fails closed.

reviews.reason: Rust accepts the reactive loop return only with FICT-R006 fallback rather than a guaranteed fine-grained lowering.
reviews.finalPlan: Retain the structured fallback diagnostic and avoid advertising the input as native capability.
reviews.removalCondition: Remove if the loop return gains a proven reactive lowering or becomes a hard rejection.

reviews.reason: Rust executes reactive do-while continue semantics and returns the proven value 5.
reviews.finalPlan: Keep the executable loop oracle.
reviews.removalCondition: Remove only if the lowering is retired or Babel accepts the request.

reviews.reason: Rust executes reactive while-break semantics and returns the proven value 6.
reviews.finalPlan: Keep the executable loop oracle.
reviews.removalCondition: Remove only if the lowering is retired or Babel accepts the request.

reviews.reason: Rust executes reactive for-break semantics and returns the proven value 15.
reviews.finalPlan: Keep the executable loop oracle.
reviews.removalCondition: Remove only if the lowering is retired or Babel accepts the request.

reviews.reason: Rust emits a write to a const derived binding that Babel rejects during semantic validation.
reviews.finalPlan: Reject writes to derived bindings with a stable diagnostic at the write span.
reviews.removalCondition: Remove this review when Rust rejects the derived write.

reviews.reason: An update to a destructured state alias compiles and later throws TypeError.
reviews.finalPlan: Track destructured aliases from reactive roots and reject update expressions.
reviews.removalCondition: Remove this review when Rust rejects the update with the stable alias-write diagnostic.

reviews.reason: A destructuring assignment writes through a readonly state-derived alias and reaches runtime.
reviews.finalPlan: Reject destructuring assignment targets that resolve to reactive aliases.
reviews.removalCondition: Remove this review when Rust rejects the destructuring write.

reviews.reason: A postfix update to a reactive alias is accepted even though it cannot update the source state.
reviews.finalPlan: Reject update expressions on reactive aliases.
reviews.removalCondition: Remove this review when Rust rejects the update with the stable alias-write diagnostic.

reviews.reason: A captured reactive alias can be assigned inside a nested function while the rendered state stays unchanged.
reviews.finalPlan: Carry alias provenance through closure capture and reject the nested assignment.
reviews.removalCondition: Remove this review when Rust rejects the captured alias write.

reviews.reason: A captured reactive alias update is accepted while the rendered state stays unchanged.
reviews.finalPlan: Carry alias provenance through closure capture and reject the nested update.
reviews.removalCondition: Remove this review when Rust rejects the captured alias update.

reviews.reason: Multi-hop state aliasing loses provenance before a destructured update and compiles to a runtime TypeError.
reviews.finalPlan: Propagate reactive provenance transitively before validating destructured writes.
reviews.removalCondition: Remove this review when Rust rejects the transitive destructured alias write.

reviews.reason: The specification fixture's alias reassignment is accepted with only an unrelated no-return advisory.
reviews.finalPlan: Restore the specification's hard alias-write validation.
reviews.removalCondition: Remove this review when Rust rejects the fixture for the alias write.

reviews.reason: Rust intentionally does not reproduce Babel's FICT-R003 warning, so strictReactivity no longer escalates this input.
reviews.finalPlan: Document the removed warning family and retain a runtime oracle for the supported behavior.
reviews.removalCondition: Remove if FICT-R003 is restored or the legacy compatibility baseline is retired.
